prompt: A photorealistic photo captures a lively sandy beach scene under bright midday sun. In the left foreground, a young woman in a red swimsuit holds a blue frisbee, looking toward a golden retriever sitting on the sand next to her. The dog wears a green bandana and looks up expectantly at the frisbee. To the right of the dog, a small child in yellow trunks builds a sandcastle using a plastic shovel. Behind the child, an older man in a white shirt and beige shorts leans on a wooden walking stick, watching the activity with a smile. In the center foreground, a large striped beach umbrella casts a shadow over a cooler filled with ice and drinks. A teenage boy in blue swim trunks stands next to the cooler, pouring soda into a clear cup. On the far right, a couple sits on a woven mat; the woman adjusts her sunglasses while the man points at something in the distance. A seagull perches on the edge of the cooler, observing the scene. The background features gentle ocean waves crashing onto the shore under a clear blue sky, with distant sailboats visible on the horizon. The lighting is harsh and direct, creating sharp shadows on the textured sand.
